task: Generate one complete, canonical sitemap.xml for all indexable vcarpets.com routes and content
approvedBy: Site owner approval on 2026-09-20 to include every indexable page in https://www.vcarpets.com/sitemap.xml, exclude noindex, thank-you, privacy, search and parameter URLs, and retain the canonical no-trailing-slash URL format
notes: Affected public endpoints: /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt. Add a build-time static route scanner and a content-backed sitemap entry registry. The generated sitemap must include all canonical indexable pages, including product categories and details, About, Solutions, Global Markets, case studies, B2B Insights articles, FAQ, Commercial Terms, Technical Documents and Contact. Exclude noindex routes, /thank-you, /privacy-policy, search routes and URLs with query parameters or fragments. Sitemap URLs must use https://www.vcarpets.com without a trailing slash, except that non-root path URLs retain their paths. Do not change published content routes, canonical generation, page metadata, tracking or conversion paths.
